purpose: Universal release work-sample qualification for the exact frozen Content Architecture v0.4 candidate after targeted/P0 r4 PASS.

prior_evidence.reuse_scope: Targeted/stochastic boundary reliability only. It does not substitute for authentic universal work-sample quality evidence.

work_sample_scope.work_sample_outputs: open professional architecture artifacts under a candidate-visible JSON contract; no hidden canonical answer tokens

evaluation_model.mechanical_contract: Deterministic parse/shape/type checks only; professional correctness is not encoded as hidden exact tokens.
evaluation_model.professional_judgment: Two blind independently-invoked calibrated judge artifacts assess only the supplied brief, candidate artifact and frozen rubric.
evaluation_model.judge_limit: Both judges use the same preregistered Codex model/runtime because no paid API credentials are used; independent prompts/contexts reduce but do not eliminate common-model correlation.
evaluation_model.calibration_rule: Each judge is calibrated before any universal candidate call on fresh candidate-independent strong-vs-challenger reference pairs derived from stable profession boundaries and frozen before execution.

runtime.runtime_drift_rule: If exact CLI/model/reasoning/auth binding changes before the first scored universal candidate call, close this cycle NOT_EXECUTABLE instead of silently changing the pin.

budget_gate.objective: Obtain universal release evidence without paid API credentials and without repeating targeted r4 coverage unnecessarily.
budget_gate.checkpoint_policy: No automatic blind retry. Preserve completed evidence and diagnose runtime failure before any resume.

integrity_rules: Do not modify the candidate during this cycle.
Do not modify author, judges, runner, thresholds, calibration references or work samples after the first universal candidate call.
Do not tune judges or rubric to candidate outputs.
Do not expose sealed work-sample text, calibration references or master key to the candidate runtime beyond the one assigned task.
A construct defect discovered after scored calls burns this cycle rather than being patched in place.
r4 evidence may support unchanged targeted/stochastic reliability only; it cannot be relabeled as universal work-sample quality evidence.
